artworks.title: Plate Number 122. Descending an incline with a bucket of water in each hand
artworks.description: This photograph captures sequential motion images of an individual carrying a bucket. Different perspectives are shown in each row: a side view at the top, a front view in the middle, and a rear view at the bottom. The frames depict various phases of motion as the person steps forward onto a platform, highlighting the study of movement and walking mechanics. The repeated figures in motion convey a sense of continuity and progressive action commonly seen in early motion studies.

The middle row shows the same action from a front view. The bottom row presents the action from a rear view. The frames have a neutral background with a striped pattern. The purpose of the layout is to display the gradual progression of motion systematically.
